GNS3's real bird.gns3a specifies a scsi disk interface (the same real
signal used for nethesis-nethsecurity above) - machine left at bare
"pc", letting qemu.py's own disk_bus heuristic auto-upgrade to q35.
reasons.description: 58): reaches the real 'debian login:' prompt with bird.service started - this fix depended on NPX-1167's own virtio-scsi controller fix (this profile's disk_bus is scsi; before the fix, the kernel's initramfs could not find the root filesystem device at all under the wrong emulated SCSI controller). Wave 38.12/NPX-1167.",

settings.description: CZ.NIC BIRD internet routing daemon. Real image sourced 2026-09-17 from a ready-made Debian+bird2 qcow2 build (BIRD's own upstream project distributes only a Linux package, not a VM image) - md5-verified byte-for-byte against the published checksum (029cf1756201ee79497c169502b08b88). Live-boot-verified through netplex's real platform (rule #58): reaches the real 'debian login:' prompt with bird.service started - this fix depended on NPX-1167's own virtio-scsi controller fix (this profile's disk_bus is scsi; before the fix, the kernel's initramfs could not find the root filesystem device at all under the wrong emulated SCSI controller). Wave 38.12/NPX-1167.
